flavor_text: The old forest road narrows beneath a bright green canopy.
A quiet howl answers from the bend ahead.
The ground softens underfoot, and the glade begins to move.
A covered cart waits beside the trail, its little lantern still warm.
At the forest center, the oldest roots twist around a dark crown.
A goblin scout watches the road from beneath the whispering boughs.
Sparks linger between the trees like unfinished thoughts.
Heat ripples across the glade as living flame takes shape.
A covered cart waits where the whispering paths cross.
A buried forge wakes, and an ancient golem steps from the sparks.
A pale light slips between the ruined shelves and bars the way.
A ruined lectern still keeps its place among the trees.
Frost gathers across the old stone as an elemental rises.
A lantern-lit merchant has made camp among the fallen stacks.
The archive doors freeze shut as the Frostwarden descends.
